information_completeness.reasoning: All core physics concepts and dialogue beats are present: probability wave vs matter wave, Born rule/psi squared, classical optics analogy (E²), independence of amplitude/width, Heisenberg uncertainty, diffraction/Abbe limit, evanescent waves, and super-resolution techniques. evaluation.overall_comment:
The translation successfully conveys the scientific podcast's dialogue in Urdu, preserving the conversational tone and technical core. It demonstrates a solid grasp of quantum mechanics and classical optics terminology. However, it exhibits occasional mechanical phrasing, minor grammatical inconsistencies, and a noticeable speaker-label error that affect overall fluency. With polishing for natural Urdu syntax and precise physics terminology, it would reach professional standards. Suitable for an educated audience familiar with basic scientific discourse in Urdu.
